a.xlink:title: Clear any failed-login lockout for the (address, username) pair, e.g. after a successful login.
True if the (address, username) pair is already locked out of logging in.
Seconds remaining before the login rate limit for the (address, username) pair lifts....
Returns a QString from a std::string, truncated to at most MAX_NAME_LENGTH bytes.
Record a failed login attempt for the (address, username) pair; returns true if now locked out.
True when only challenge-response logins are accepted (strict mode).
